page.overview:
What is Assamite antitribu?

The Assamite antitribu, also known as the Angels of Caine or the Unconquered, are those Assamites who have forsaken Alamut and joined the Sabbat.

The first Assamites to join the Anarch Revolt were allies of Lasombra anarchs, including Karif al-Numair, who aided Gratiano de Veronese and became the first hulul of the Unconquered. Around the same time, members of the Lost Tribe also joined the anarchs, taking the name "the Black Hand" to disguise their true intentions. The largest wave of defectors, sometimes called "the Unfettered", left their clan shortly after the Treaty of Tyre, led by Izhim ur-Baal and Djuhah.

As exiles and defectors from Alamut, the antitribu were either never subjected to the Tremere Blood Curse (the early Unconquered and the Lost Tribe) or broke it shortly after it was imposed on the clan (the Unfettered). The Assamites of the Sabbat were therefore free to drink the blood of all vampires while their parent clan could not, and were often considered a separate bloodline from other Assamites.

During the Assamite Schism, after Ur-Shulgi awoke and broke the Tremere Curse, a new wave of defectors joined the Sabbat, even as several elders among the Unconquered returned to Alamut to serve the Shepherd of Haqim. As the Tremere Curse no longer applied to anyone in the clan, these new antitribu were indistinguishable from their Unconquered precursors.
